report_name: CISA Unveils "CISA 2030" for Proactive Cyber Defense

identities.name: U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA)
identities.description: Author and publisher of the "CISA 2030: Defend, Harden, Prevail" strategic plan, aimed at shifting the U.S. to a proactive cyber defense posture for critical infrastructure.

identities.name: U.S. Government
identities.description: The national government entity under which CISA operates and whose broader cyber strategy is aligned with the CISA 2030 plan.
